senses.gloss: m. (perh. a corrupt. of קורדקא, v. קוּרְדְּקִין) a shoe made entirely of goats’ hair or of cloth, slipper.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 102b:7">Yeb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא קו׳ מקרי</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="S02158"><he>קרקא</he></cite>) such a shoe has the special name of ḳurḳa (and is not included in <he>נעל</he> or <he>מנעול</he>).
